text:
nina_partners: Need approval for a partner discount exception for EdgeScale. They want to resell Redwood for a strategic healthcare account. Ask: 30% margin to partner on list price for first 6 months + a one-time co-sell rebate of $18,500 if they hit $60k ARR within 90 days.

kevin_sales: Context: EdgeScale brings channel reach in EU healthcare and has an active LOI with a large hospital system. Without the partner margin they won't supplant incumbent. This is a time-sensitive ask (deal desk wants answer within 24h).

maria_finance: Quick checks: 30% partner margin would imply a cost to us of roughly $24k over 6 months based on expected booking; the rebate is a separate sales incentive. Delegation: rebates >$15k need Finance Manager+Sales Ops sign-off; any structural discount to list >25% requires CFO approval per policy.

tori_partnerops: Also need to confirm rev recognition: partner margin vs direct sale changes routing. We should specify whether Redwood invoices partner or customer. EdgeScale requests we invoice the customer and pay them margin. That impacts AR and revenue mapping.

sam_legal: Flags: we need an MSA addendum that clarifies reseller relationship, indemnities, and data handling for healthcare customers. Rebate language: "Performance-based one-time rebate payable upon verification of ARR target within 90 days; subject to audit." I can draft ASAP. No showstoppers but need signatures.

devon_fp&a: Accounting: If we invoice customer and pay partner a margin, revenue is still recognized gross if we control the service; otherwise, net recognition possible. For simplicity and to keep margin treatment consistent, recommend invoicing partner (EdgeScale) and let them handle customer billing. That makes the partner a reseller and we book revenue net of the margin as contra-revenue (GL 6200). Also need to set aside accrual for the $18.5k rebate until the 90-day milestone.

billing-bot: Note: Setting up partner payouts requires vendor setup in AR module and tax forms (W-8/W-9 equivalent). One-off rebate >$15k will create a pending liability entry until paid. System requires CFO approval for discount structure >25% list.

maria_finance: Given the >25% list discount ask, we need CFO approval. Also prefer invoicing partner to simplify revenue accounting. If CFO approves, finance will create vendor record and accruals.

jonah_cfo: Reviewed financials and strategic rationale. Approve the following on a conditional basis: 1) Allow 30% partner margin for first 6 months provided EdgeScale is invoiced directly (Redwood books net revenue, GL 6200). 2) Approve $18,500 one-time co-sell rebate accrual to be paid after milestone verification. Conditions: partner must sign reseller addendum, pass compliance review for healthcare data handling, and submit tax forms. Sales to obtain LOI + evidence of potential $60k ARR.

kevin_sales: We'll get the LOI and compliance artifacts today. EdgeScale can accept invoicing model.

nina_partners: Thanks. I'll coordinate legal & partner ops. Action items: @sam_legal draft addendum; @tori_partnerops kick off compliance checklist; @maria_finance create accrual entry and vendor setup pending signed docs. Tag: FIN-8234.

maria_finance: Creating accrual for $18,500 under GL 6501 and vendor onboarding placeholder. Will not post payment until milestone verification. Closing the ask. :white_check_mark:

billing-bot: Partner setup ticket PAR-2026 created. Reminder: Payouts require monthly reconciliation and a partner ledger entry.

kevin_sales: Appreciate the fast turnaround. We'll target LOI + tax forms by EOD.

nina_partners: Loop closed for now. Will report back once docs are signed. :rocket:
